summary: Implementation plan for the PetroTechnics Superadmin Dashboard and full-stack PostgreSQL migration eliminating all frontend mock data, featuring role-based access control, real-time CRUD across all 5 operational modules (Catalog & FOB Pricing, RFQ Pipeline, Insights/Price Trends/Corridors, Document Hub & Audit Logs, Roles/FX/Desks), one-time database seeding, and Vercel + Supabase PostgreSQL deployment parity.
